description:
We are seeking a technical GIS developer for developing Esri ArcGIS Server 10.4x Javascript API (HTML5) and SharePoint 2013 solutions. The candidate will have design, development, implementation, and support experience.  

 
 The Enterprise GIS team is composed of 3 HTML5/JavaScript developers, a data manager, and team leader. The team supports over 180 ArcGIS Desktop users and approximately 60,000 annual ArcGIS Server web visits. Applications support GIS portal, feature mapping, project planning, emergency operations, permitting, safety, and traffic records. 
 
 


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
